text: To reset your password, open Settings, choose Security and click Reset password. A reset link is emailed and expires after 30 minutes.
In the EU, customers may request a refund within 14 days of purchase under the right of withdrawal. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 10 business days.
In the US, refunds are available within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are issued as store credit unless the payment was made by card.
Standard shipping takes 5 to 7 business days. Express shipping takes 2 business days and costs 15 dollars.
The Pro plan costs 29 dollars per month and includes 5 seats, priority support and a 99.9 percent uptime SLA.
The Free plan includes 1 seat, community support and a limit of 1000 requests per month.
The API allows 60 requests per minute per key. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 and a Retry-After header.
Single sign-on via SAML is available on the Enterprise plan only. Setup requires an admin to upload the identity provider metadata.
Customer data is retained for 90 days after account deletion, then permanently erased from backups within 30 days.
Two-factor authentication can be enabled under Settings then Security using an authenticator app. Recovery codes are shown once.
Invoices are emailed on the first day of each billing cycle and can be downloaded from Billing then History as PDF.
You can cancel at any time from Billing. Access continues until the end of the paid period and no partial refunds are given.
